Standard: Store(s) and store components are capable of being accurately aligned or boresighted to a sight axis or datum line and retain sufficient alignment with any aiming or fire control system so as not to degrade store pointing accuracy or flight operations within the scope of AW (e.g., internal or external guns, external rocket pods, laser systems, seekers, fire control radars, pylons). Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Ground test: Perform alignment checks via ground fit and ground fire test(s) IAW MIL- HDBK-1763, Test 101, Test 102, Test 161, and Test 272 and MIL-STD-1289, Alignment of Stores and Installation Test Method sections. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Examination.
  (1) Alignment or boresight procedures and realignment intervals are included in the pertinent documentation required for fielding. Analysis.
    (1) Verify through analysis of ground test reports and post-flight test inspection that stores can retain alignment, boresight, and the inspection intervals are established to prevent stores from falling out of alignment IAW MIL-HDBK-1763, Test 273.
